h1: Custom Zippo Candles for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom Zippo candles for your brand. Perfect for giveaways and events. Shop now at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Zippo candles pair the iconic brand heritage of Zippo with premium candle quality, making them a memorable giveaway for corporate events, trade shows, or client appreciation. Unlike generic candles, the Zippo name adds instant recognition and durability, especially when combined with a Zippo lighter. These candles are available in classic scents and are easily customizable with your logo using screen printing or labels, ensuring your brand stands out at any gathering.
heroAltText: Custom Zippo candles with branded logo, perfect for corporate gifts and promotional events.
